preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= N for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for x in line.split())
preconditions.description: All city identifiers in the input are integers between 1 and N (inclusive).
The input has exactly E + 1 lines (1 header line and E road lines).

preconditions.expression: all(a != b for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for a, b in [tuple(map(int, line.split()))])
preconditions.description: No road connects a city to itself.
Each road is uniquely defined by a pair of distinct cities.

postconditions.description: Output is either 'NO' (no solution) or 'YES' followed by exactly E lines of road orientations.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'YES' and all(line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] or line.split()[::-1] in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: Each output road is either the same as an input road or its reverse (orientation change allowed).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'YES' and any(all(city in path for city in range(1, N + 1)) and len(path) == E + 1 for path in get_all_eulerian_circuits(output_roads))
postconditions.description: If 'YES', the output road network must contain at least one Eulerian circuit (tourist-friendly condition).
